'''August 2000 Sioux Falls tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Dragon's Den, Sioux Falls, South Dakota on 13 August 2000. [[TJ Olson]] won it. It is known from Tyler Williams's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1125">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-sioux-falls-sd-8-13-00d1125/ sioux-falls-sd-8-13-00], DeckTech (Tyler "rugman11" Williams, 14 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-14-sioux-falls-sd-8-13-00d1125/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Dragon's Den, Sioux Falls, South Dakota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[TJ Olson]]
